title: Natural Liquid Cells: Nanoscale Fluid Inclusions in Asteroid Samples
content: The samples of asteroid Bennu returned by NASA’s OSIRIS-REx mission are primarily composed of minerals that formed through water-rock interactions, e.g., sheet silicates, magnetite, carbonates, and pyrrhotite [1]. Having precipitated from solution, each of these minerals can trap samples of the fluid from which they precipitated [2], effectively making them natural liquid cells. Thus, as direct samples of an extraterrestrial hydrothermal system, such fluid inclusions can provide unique insights into the conditions associated with the ancient aqueous system that formed Bennu.
